home.empty: Nothing yet. Hold {{hotkey}} in any app and talk.

history.confirmClear: Delete every dictation? This can't be undone.
history.empty: Your dictations will show up here

dictionary.vocabularyHint: Names and terms to spell exactly.
dictionary.replacementsHint: Applied after cleanup, whole words, any case.

general.idleBubbleHint: A small bubble at the bottom of the screen. Click it to dictate hands-free.

shortcut.recordingHint: Press the keys, then release them
shortcut.altGr: On Spanish keyboards Right Alt is AltGr, which also types characters like @.
shortcut.doubleTapHint: Milliseconds between taps to start hands-free (150–800).
shortcut.autoStopHint: Minutes before a hands-free dictation ends on its own (1–60).

mic.title: Microphone
mic.noSignal: No signal: this mic is off, muted or asleep. Pick another one.
mic.noise: Only background noise. Speak to test it; if the bar barely moves, raise the input volume in system sound settings.
mic.unavailable: This microphone can't be opened. Pick another one.
mic.blocked: Burbuja isn't allowed to use the microphone, so it only gets silence.
mic.noDevice: No microphone detected. Plug one in.

transcription.engineHint: Speech is transcribed on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
transcription.gpuHint: Much faster. Turn off if transcription fails to start.
transcription.unloadHint: Minutes without dictating before freeing memory (0 = never).

cleanup.providerHint: Removes filler words and fixes punctuation with Ollama or LM Studio running on this computer.
cleanup.modelHint: Leave empty for the provider's default.
cleanup.styleHint: The presets change capitalization and punctuation, never your words.

examples.standard: Sounds good, I'll send the report by Friday.
examples.formal: Sounds good. I'll send the report by Friday.
examples.casual: Sounds good, I'll send the report by Friday
examples.very_casual: sounds good i'll send the report by friday
examples.excited: Sounds good! I'll send the report by Friday!

cleanup.customPlaceholder: Turn this into short bullet points: ${output}
cleanup.customHint: Write what the model should do. ${output} is replaced with what you said; without it, your words go at the end. Leave it empty to use the standard cleanup.

providers.testFailed: Cleanup is off. Pick Ollama or LM Studio
providers.testRaw: No change: the local model failed or its output was rejected

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.previewHint: Hear each cue at the current volume.

advanced.insertHint: Typing works where pasting is blocked, but it's slower.
advanced.restoreHint: Puts back what you had copied and keeps dictations out of Win+V history.
advanced.keepAudioHint: Off by default. Audio stays on this computer.
advanced.confirmReset: Reset every setting to its default? Your history stays.
advanced.timingsEmpty: Dictate something to see where the time goes.

about.privacy: No telemetry. Everything stays on this computer: transcription and AI cleanup run locally.

permissions.title: Allow Burbuja on this Mac
permissions.body: Burbuja needs these to hear you, catch the shortcut and paste the text in any app. Audio stays on this computer.
permissions.bodyWindows: Windows decides which apps can use the microphone. If access is off, Burbuja records silence and dictation doesn't work.
permissions.allSet: All set: Burbuja has the permissions it needs.
permissions.restartHint: You allowed it, but macOS only applies it after Burbuja restarts.
permissions.rerunHint: Go through the permissions, microphone and model steps again.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.deniedMac: You declined it before. In Privacy & Security > Microphone, turn on Burbuja.

block.device: Microphone access is off for this whole device. Turn it on in Privacy > Microphone (may need an administrator).
block.apps: Turn on “Let apps access your microphone”.
block.desktopApps: Turn on “Let desktop apps access your microphone”, at the bottom of the page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To catch the shortcut and paste the text where you're typing.

inputMonitoring.title: Input Monitoring
inputMonitoring.body: This Mac also wants it to catch the shortcut.

noMicrophone.title: No microphone detected
noMicrophone.body: Plug one in (or check it isn't disabled in your sound settings).

banner.body: Dictation won't work until you fix it.

permissions.stillOff: Burbuja already switched on but still pending? Press “Fix permission”: it clears the old approval and asks again.

onboarding.welcome: Just talk. Burbuja types, in any app.
onboarding.micBody: Say something. The bar should move.
onboarding.trayTip: Tip: drag the Burbuja icon from ^ in the taskbar to keep it in view.
onboarding.pendingLater: It will show as pending in Settings > Permissions.

errors.mic_silent: No sound from the mic. Pick another one
errors.service_timeout: The local AI model took too long
